requirements.name: The robot is the first thing you see
requirements.why: "100% there should be a urdf showing"; today's view is a grey arc in an empty 3D view.
requirements.passCondition: On open, the URDF arm moving along the trajectory dominates the screen, framed on the arm, with where the tool goes.

anchors.1: No robot, or a robot lost in a corner / badly framed.
anchors.3: The robot is there but shares the screen evenly with plots, or framing needs fixing by hand.
anchors.5: The arm, framed, is the hero; the tool's path reads at a glance.

requirements.name: Joint motion legible, in degrees, few panels
requirements.why: Today: nine separate per-joint q/qd/qdd panels that don't say which is which at a glance.
requirements.passCondition: Every joint's q (and qd/qdd where shown) is readable with its name, in degrees, against its limits, in a handful of panels.

anchors.1: Many unlabeled panels, radians, no limits.
anchors.3: Labelled and in degrees, but spread over many panels or no limits.
anchors.5: A few panels, every series named, degrees, limits visible.

requirements.name: A stock viewer for every JointTrajectory
requirements.why: "this should basically be the stock trajectory rerun viewer"; "For all of the robotmsgs I would like to have a bunch of Rerun viewers".
requirements.passCondition: One function from a robot_msgs JointTrajectory + a URDF to a recording, in robot_msgs' entity layout, that works for any arm and any length.

anchors.1: Hard-wired to the UR5e or this trajectory.
anchors.3: General, but outside robot_msgs' layout or needs per-arm tuning.
anchors.5: Any JointTrajectory + URDF, robot_msgs' layout, nothing per-arm.

requirements.name: Built on what we already liked
requirements.why: "Please find the previous examples we have done and base yours off of that."
requirements.passCondition: It visibly grows from a previous pick (questions / evo / Solo Run Dashboard / robot_msgs' show) rather than starting over.

anchors.5: A clear evolution of a named previous layout.

requirements.name: Scrubbing feels right
requirements.why: The point of Rerun here is playing the motion back.
requirements.passCondition: Moving the playhead moves the arm and a cursor in every plot together; nothing jumps or reloads.

anchors.1: Plots and arm out of step, or the time panel hidden.
anchors.3: In step, but the plots don't show where you are.
anchors.5: Arm, trail and every plot's cursor move together.

hardGates.name: The URDF robot moves with the trajectory
Opens with no errors in the real Rerun 0.40 web viewer
hardGates.why: shoot.cjs with SHOOT_DEBUG, no ERROR lines.

hardGates.name: Angles in degrees
hardGates.why: Zach's standing rule for anything he reads.
